extrapolation.policy: Positive linear tails outside fitted support; overhangs reported separately from between-datum evidence

historical_magnitude.relative_view_identification: Data establish relative SIDE/TOP non-affinity for these correspondences. Choosing SIDE as the gauge and TOP as distorted is an explicit hypothesis; no independent metrology identifies an undistorted source.

top.model: rejected PCHIP candidate, five trusted anchors
top.rms_definition: All 12 unique observed longitudinal landmarks, including held-out overhang observations and both exact axle anchors; excludes duplicate cowl/A-base alias.
top.derivative_policy: Analytic exact extrema of each quadratic derivative, including endpoint slopes; strictly positive, C1, no foldovers. Normalized scale is relative to the unique axle-locked affine baseline.
top.correction_definition: (f(r)-r) times source TOP wheelbase, 470 px, or authoritative 2730 mm. Not residual-to-model error. Additional raw-to-affine-domain scaling is explicit in candidate data.
top.extrapolation_policy: Outside [front axle,rear axle], positive linear endpoint tails are numerical extrapolations, not measured accepted distortion. Whole-crop extrema include these untrusted tails.

uncertainty_certificate.interpretation: Even the most favorable endpoints require >10% compression over A-to-B, so the rejection is not merely a PCHIP tuning artifact. Any smooth rectification with derivative everywhere >=0.9 relative to the axle-locked affine map cannot satisfy these correspondences at full uncertainty.

historical_magnitude.decision: REFERENCE SOURCE: INCONSISTENT under declared correspondences and a modest one-axis nonlinear-rectification model. Stop before activating calibration or reprojecting/editing the cage. This does not exclude all physical perspective models; new consistent references or independently justified correspondences/projection are required.
